_about: Johto chapters. Written from the natural playthrough (blonde/qa/natural-run-v100, rows cited in `ev`). `basis`: played = every beat was done in the run; source = from game data only, flagged on the page.

chapters.title: New Bark Town
chapters.goal: Set your options, choose a partner and take Professor Elm’s errand west.
need: Nothing. This is where a new game begins.
quick: Create your character
After Oak’s speech, choose boy or girl and a name (START jumps to OK).
Set the challenge options
Six tabs: Mode, Features, Randomizer, Nuzlocke, Difficulty, Challenges. L / R change tab; R on the last tab saves. The Recommended defaults are fine.
Set the clock
Walk toward the stairs in your room. The confirm box opens on NO: press Up, then A.
Talk to Mom downstairs
She sends you to Professor Elm.
Visit Elm’s lab
The large building west of your house. Walk up to Elm, accept, and pick a ball: Chikorita (left), Cyndaquil (middle) or Totodile (right).
Talk to Elm again
You cannot leave before you do. He gives Mr. Pokémon’s number; the aide at the door adds a Potion.
Leave town to the west
Route 29 leads to Cherrygrove City.

p: The title screen reads POKéMON PROJECT BLONDE. With no save the menu shows only NEW GAME and OPTION. After Professor Oak’s introduction and the naming screen, a disclaimer explains the challenge settings, then a six-tab menu opens: Mode, Features, Randomizer, Nuzlocke, Difficulty and Challenges.

The Recommended defaults give a Gen 7 movepool, the physical / special split, Fairy type, reusable TMs, a real-time clock, no randomizer, no Nuzlocke, no level cap and normal experience. Settings can be changed later from any PC, but Nuzlocke, Randomizer, Difficulty and Challenge settings can only be made easier afterwards, so decide those now.
You start in bed. Two things are already in your Bag: the Exp. Share (a Key Item, switched off) and the GB Player.

Walking toward the stairs triggers the wall clock. The confirmation defaults to NO, which sends you back to the clock, so press Up first. The clock can be changed later at any Pokémon Center without penalty.

Elm’s lab is the big building west of your house. Step up to him, say yes, and choose one of the three Poké Balls on the table. Your choice also decides which partner your rival takes: the one with the type advantage over yours.

Your partner follows you on the map from the moment you receive it. Speak to Elm once more for directions to Mr. Pokémon, collect the Potion from the aide by the door, and walk west out of town onto Route 29.

items: From Elm’s aide as you leave the lab.
In your Bag from the start. Use it from Key Items to share experience with the whole party; it begins switched off.
stuck: Elm says “Wait! Where are you going?”
You picked a partner but have not spoken to Elm again. Talk to him before leaving the lab.
The clock screen keeps coming back
The yes / no box opens on NO. Press Up to select YES, then A.

chapters.title: Cherrygrove City
chapters.goal: Reach Mr. Pokémon’s house, meet your rival and bring the egg home.
need: A partner Pokémon and Elm’s errand.
quick: Follow the Guide Gent
He shows you the Pokémon Center, Mart, Route 30 and the sea.
Heal at the Pokémon Center
Your last Pokémon Center is where you return if you black out.
Go north on Route 30
Mr. Pokémon’s house is at the top of the route.
Receive the Mystery Egg and the Pokédex
Mr. Pokémon gives the egg and heals you; Professor Oak gives the Pokédex.
Answer Elm’s call, head back
He rings as you leave the house.
Battle your rival in Cherrygrove
He stops you on the east side of town with the partner that beats yours.
Return to Elm’s lab
Name the thief for the officer, hand over the egg, collect 5 Poké Balls from the aide and say goodbye to Mom.

p: Cherrygrove’s Guide Gent walks you round the town when you arrive. Heal, then follow Route 30 north; the house at the end is Mr. Pokémon’s. Inside you receive the Mystery Egg, Professor Oak hands you a Pokédex, and your party is healed.
Elm phones in a panic the moment you step outside. Walk back to Cherrygrove.
A red-haired boy blocks the east side of Cherrygrove and battles you with a single Level 5 Pokémon. Losing sends you to the Pokémon Center and he waits where he was, so you can simply try again.

Back at the lab an officer asks for the thief’s name: whatever you type becomes your rival’s name for the rest of the game (the guide calls him Silver). Give Elm the egg, take the 5 Poké Balls from the aide at the door and see Mom before setting off for Violet City through Routes 30 and 31.
The cave mouth on the east side of Route 31 can be entered without Flash. Geodude, Zubat and Dunsparce live near the entrance; a Geodude caught here is a strong answer to the first Gym.

bosses.title: Rival
know: One Pokémon at Level 5. If you lose he stays put: heal and walk back.

items: From Mr. Pokémon. You hand it to Elm on your return.
Five from Elm’s aide once the egg is delivered.
stuck: Where is Mr. Pokémon?
North end of Route 30, the last house before the route turns toward Route 31.
I lost to my rival
Nothing is lost. You wake in the Cherrygrove Pokémon Center and he is still standing on the east side of town.

chapters.title: Violet City
chapters.goal: Beat Falkner, climb Sprout Tower and collect the egg. All three are required to leave.
need: Nothing blocks the Gym: Sprout Tower is not required to enter it.
quick: Train before the Gym
Falkner’s Noctowl is Level 11 and lowers accuracy. A second Pokémon helps: Geodude from Dark Cave resists Flying.
Beat Falkner
Violet Gym, two Bird Keepers first. Reward: Zephyr Badge and TM51 Roost.
Collect the egg
Elm calls as you leave. His aide in the Pokémon Center gives you an Egg and the Exp. Share S.
Climb Sprout Tower
North of the city. Reach the top floor, watch your rival leave, then beat Elder Li for HM05 Flash.
Go south to Route 32
The man at the top of the route lets you past and gives a Miracle Seed.

p: Bird Keeper Rod has a Level 7 Pidgey and Abe a Level 9 Spearow. Falkner leads with Pidgey (Level 8, Sand Attack) and follows with Noctowl (Level 11, holding a Sitrus Berry, with Mud-Slap and Peck). The accuracy drops are what lose this fight for a lone starter; in the playthrough a Level 20 Quilava with Flame Wheel and a Geodude won it comfortably.
If a level-up move was skipped along the way, relearn it for free: open the Pokémon’s Summary, go to the Moves page and press START.
Elm rings when you step outside the Gym. In the Pokémon Center his aide hands over the Egg together with an Exp. Share S. A Kimono Girl comments on the egg at the door.

The tower is a stair puzzle around a swaying pillar. From the entrance take the middle stairs up to 2F, follow the top row to the right-hand stairs and go back down to 1F’s right column. Cross the top row of 1F to the left stairs, climb to 2F’s left column and take the bottom stairs to 3F.
On 3F your rival beats the Elder and leaves by Escape Rope. That scene is what the man on Route 32 checks for. Then battle Elder Li for HM05 Flash, and pick up the Escape Rope on the same floor.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Falkner
know: Sand Attack and Mud-Slap stack accuracy drops: switch out rather than fight through them.
Rock and Electric moves are super effective; Geodude from Dark Cave walls both of his Pokémon.

items: From Elder Li at the top of Sprout Tower.
From Elm’s aide in the Violet Pokémon Center after the Zephyr Badge. It hatches into Togepi.
From the man at the top of Route 32 once he lets you pass.
stuck: A man on Route 32 keeps sending me back

He checks three things in order: you have seen your rival leave the top of Sprout Tower, you hold the Zephyr Badge, and you took the Egg from Elm’s aide in the Violet Pokémon Center. Sprout Tower is mandatory in Project Blonde.
I keep losing to Falkner
Bring a second Pokémon and more levels. Geodude (Dark Cave, east side of Route 31) resists Flying; switch out when your accuracy has been lowered.

chapters.title: Route 32
chapters.goal: Walk the long road south and cross Union Cave to Azalea Town.
need: Sprout Tower scene, Zephyr Badge and the Egg (the Route 32 gate).
quick: Pass the man at the top of Route 32
He hands you a Miracle Seed.
Follow Route 32 south
Trainers line the path; a Pokémon Center sits near the cave.
Cross Union Cave 1F
Keep to the ground floor and exit to the south.
Walk Route 33 west
Azalea Town is at the end.

p: Route 32 is the longest road so far. Trainers stand all along it and inside the cave; a Pokémon Center near the cave mouth lets you heal before going in.
Union Cave’s ground floor is a straight crossing from the north entrance to the south exit. The lower floors are optional and need Surf. Route 33 is a short, rainy stretch into Azalea Town.
The Ruins of Alph open off Route 32’s west side. They are optional and can wait.

stuck: The road south is blocked
See the Violet City chapter: Sprout Tower, the Zephyr Badge and the Egg are all needed.
next: Route 33, west of Union Cave’s south exit.

chapters.title: Azalea Town
chapters.goal: Clear Team Rocket out of Slowpoke Well, then take the Hive Badge.
need: Nothing new. The Gym is closed until the well is cleared.
quick: Visit Kurt’s house
He storms off to the well and the Rocket guard at its mouth leaves.
Clear Slowpoke Well B1F
Three grunts, then Proton. You are returned to Kurt’s house and given a Fast Ball.
Clear Azalea Gym
Ride the Ariados lifts to Bugsy. Reward: Hive Badge and TM89 U-turn.
Battle your rival
He waits at the Ilex Forest gate on the west side of town.

p: A Rocket grunt guards the well on arrival. Talk to Kurt in his house and he runs to deal with it himself; follow him down. Three grunts (two Rattata users and an Elekid) stand between you and Proton, whose lead is a Level 12 Koffing. When he is beaten the scene carries you back to Kurt’s house, where Kurt gives you a Fast Ball.

The Gym floor is crossed on Ariados lifts. From the bottom row, the left lift lands in the middle pocket, which connects to the central corridor. The middle lift goes to Benny and the right lift to the twins Amy & May (a Double Battle).
From the corridor, the right-hand lift of the upper row leads to the top-centre platform and Bugsy. The middle one is a dead end with Josh; the left one reaches Al.
Your rival stops you at the gate to Ilex Forest with three Pokémon led by a Level 15 Zubat. His starter has evolved.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Bugsy
know: Fire, Flying and Rock all hit his team hard.

stuck: The Gym is blocked
Clear Slowpoke Well first: talk to Kurt in his house, then follow him into the well on the east side of town.
Which lift reaches Bugsy?
Bottom row: left lift. Then, from the corridor, the right-hand lift of the upper row.
next: West gate of Azalea Town, after the rival battle.

chapters.title: Ilex Forest
chapters.goal: Herd the Farfetch’d back to its owner for HM01 Cut, then walk to Goldenrod.
need: The Hive Badge (your rival waits at the gate until then).
quick: Talk to the apprentice
Just inside the forest. His Farfetch’d has run off.
Approach the bird from the north
It flees away from you and hops to a second spot further west.
Approach it from the south
It walks back to the apprentice.
Receive HM01 Cut
The charcoal master appears and hands it over.
Cut the small tree and head north
A Kimono Girl greets you; the north gate opens onto Route 34.

p: The bird always runs away from the side you approach. At its first spot, come at it from the north (facing south) and it hops west to a second clearing. There, come at it from the south (facing north) and it returns to the apprentice.
Approaching from the south at the first spot only sends it on a loop around the forest, which is why this puzzle can feel endless.

The charcoal master then gives you HM01 Cut. In Project Blonde an HM in your Bag is enough to use its field move: face the small tree and press A. Beyond it a Kimono Girl speaks to you, and the north gate leads to Route 34 and the Day Care.

items: From the charcoal master in Ilex Forest once the Farfetch’d is returned.
stuck: The Farfetch’d keeps running in circles
Go to its first spot and walk at it from the north. When it stops at the next spot, walk at it from the south.
Do I have to teach Cut?
No. Holding the HM in your Bag lets you press A on a cuttable tree.
next: North through the gate and up Route 34.

chapters.title: Goldenrod City
chapters.sub: Radio Tower, Whitney & the Department Store
chapters.goal: Win a Radio Card to bring Whitney back to her Gym, then beat her.
need: Nothing new. The Gym door is blocked until you take the Radio Tower quiz.
quick: Go to the Radio Tower
North-west of the city. Talk to the receptionist across the counter.
Answer the quiz
Yes, Yes, No, Yes, No. You win the Radio Card and Whitney goes back to her Gym.
Build a team of three or four
Trade a Drowzee to Jose on the Department Store’s 6th floor for a Machop; catch Psyduck or others on Route 35.
Beat Whitney
Clefairy, Teddiursa and Miltank.
Get the Badge
She only cries at first. Walk one step toward the exit, let Bridget speak, then talk to Whitney again.
Visit the Flower Shop
East side of the city. The girl gives you the SquirtBottle.

p: A woman stands in the Gym doorway: Whitney is at the Radio Tower. Inside the tower, speak to the receptionist from across the counter and take the five-question quiz. The answers are Yes, Yes, No, Yes, No. Two of them differ from other games: here Kurt works with Berries, not Apricorns, and the Game Corner slots do not show Charmander.
The prize is the Radio Card for your Pokégear. Whitney congratulates you and returns to the Gym, and the woman at the door steps aside.

Whitney is the first real wall. A two-Pokémon party lost to her twice in the playthrough. On the Department Store’s 6th floor, Jose trades his Machop, nicknamed Muscle, for a Drowzee, which is common in the grass on Route 34. The trade opens a PC-style screen: move the cursor up to the Party Pokémon button, press A, and choose the Drowzee.
The 2nd floor sells Poké Balls; ten at once adds a free Premier Ball. If you are carrying the egg from Violet City it will hatch into Togepi around now.

Four trainers stand on the Clefairy-shaped path. Whitney’s Clefairy uses Charm and Sweet Kiss, Teddiursa uses Fake Tears and Mud-Slap, and Miltank (Level 21, Sitrus Berry) has Rollout, Attract, Stomp and Milk Drink. A Fighting type leading the party turns the fight.
After you win she bursts into tears and will not give you anything. Walk one step down toward the exit: Bridget stops you and explains. Now talk to Whitney again for the Plain Badge and TM45 Attract.
With the Plain Badge, the girl in the Flower Shop on the east side hands you the SquirtBottle, which you need for the odd tree on Route 36.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Whitney
know: Miltank heals with Milk Drink and builds Rollout. A Fighting type (Machop from the Department Store trade) is the cleanest answer.
Attract only affects Pokémon of the opposite gender to Miltank, which is female.
The Badge is not handed over straight after the battle: trigger Bridget’s line, then speak to Whitney again.

items: Goldenrod Flower Shop, after the Plain Badge.
Bonus for buying ten Poké Balls at once.
stuck: Whitney is not in the Gym
Take the Radio Card quiz on the ground floor of the Radio Tower. Answers: Yes, Yes, No, Yes, No.
Whitney just cries and won’t give me the Badge
Walk one step toward the Gym exit so Bridget speaks to you, then talk to Whitney again.
Jose’s trade screen confuses me
It opens on your PC box. Move the hand cursor up to the Party Pokémon button, press A to slide your party out, pick the Drowzee and confirm.

chapters.title: Route 35
chapters.goal: Water the odd tree on Route 36 and reach Ecruteak City.
need: The SquirtBottle from Goldenrod’s Flower Shop (given once you hold the Plain Badge).
quick: Walk Route 35 north
Psyduck in the grass here is the nearest Pokémon that can learn Surf.
Cross the National Park
In by the south gate, out by the east gate.
Use the SquirtBottle on the odd tree
Route 36. It attacks: a Level 20 Sudowoodo you can catch.
Go north on Route 37
Ecruteak City is at the end.

p: Route 35’s trainers are a good place to level the team you built for Whitney. The National Park lies between Routes 35 and 36: enter from the south gate and leave by the east gate.

On Route 36 the road is blocked by a tree that wriggles. Use the SquirtBottle on it and a wild Sudowoodo (Level 20) attacks. It appears only once, so save first if you want to catch it. A man nearby gives HM06 Rock Smash once the tree is gone.
Route 37 runs north to Ecruteak’s south gate.

items: From the man on Route 36 after Sudowoodo has moved. The same HM is also given in Hoenn’s Mauville City; either copy breaks rocks in every region (v102).
stuck: The tree on Route 36 won’t move
You need the SquirtBottle: Goldenrod Flower Shop, after beating Whitney and receiving the Plain Badge.
chapters.ev: v100 trace 52–58; Rock Smash source: natural-run-v101 BLOCKER-002, v102 acceptance

chapters.title: Ecruteak City
chapters.goal: Find Morty at the Burned Tower, win the Fog Badge and collect Surf at the Dance Theater.
need: Nothing new. The Gym door is blocked until you have been through the Burned Tower.
quick: Heal and meet Bill
He is in the Pokémon Center on your first visit.
Enter the Burned Tower
North-west terrace. Eusine and Morty greet you inside.
Battle your rival
At the centre of the floor. Afterwards the floor gives way.
Watch the basement scene
Raikou, Entei and Suicune run. Climb back out.
Clear Ecruteak Gym
South-west corner. The path is invisible and one tile wide. Reward: Fog Badge and TM30 Shadow Ball.
Visit the Dance Theater
Beat the Rocket grunt on the stage; the man by the exit gives HM03 Surf.

p: A sage is minding the Gym door: Morty has gone to the Burned Tower on the north-west terrace. Inside, Eusine introduces himself and Morty stands beside him. Two trainers wait on the floor, and your rival challenges you at the centre with four Pokémon led by a Level 22 Larvitar.
When the battle ends the floor collapses under you. In the basement the three legendary beasts wake and scatter. Only after this does the sage leave the Gym door.

The floor between the lit platforms cannot be seen and is one tile wide. Stepping off it drops you back to the door. The area map on the Gym’s page marks every pitfall tile. Four trainers stand along the path; Morty leads with a Level 24 Haunter.

Stepping into the theater starts a scene: a Rocket grunt is pestering a Kimono Girl. He stands on the stage. Talk to him from the stage’s left end, facing east; the tile directly below him cannot be stood on. When he is beaten, the gentleman by the exit hands you HM03 Surf.
None of the early team (the starter line, Geodude, Machop, Togepi, Sudowoodo) can learn Surf. Psyduck from Route 35 is the nearest Pokémon that can.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Morty
know: Normal and Fighting moves do nothing to his Ghosts. Dark, Ghost and (for Gengar’s line) Psychic or Ground do.
Hypnosis and Curse punish slow fights. End it quickly.

items: From the gentleman in the Dance Theater after you beat the Rocket grunt on the stage.
From the man in the house west of the Pokémon Center: say yes.
stuck: Why can’t I get into the Ecruteak Gym?
Morty is not there yet. Go into the Burned Tower, battle your rival and see the basement scene. The sage then leaves the door.
I can’t talk to the Rocket grunt in the theater
Stand on the stage’s left end and face east. The tile below him is not walkable.
I keep falling in the Gym
The walkway is invisible and one tile wide. Open the Gym’s area map and switch on Show pitfalls.
None of my Pokémon can learn Surf
Catch a Psyduck on Route 35, or any other Water type.

chapters.title: Olivine City
chapters.goal: Climb the Lighthouse and learn why Jasmine is away from her Gym.
need: Surf (for the next chapter). The Lighthouse itself needs nothing.
quick: Walk Routes 38 and 39
Near the farm, Baoba appears and adds himself to your Pokégear.
Arrive in Olivine
Your rival leaves the Gym as you approach; there is no battle.
Climb the Lighthouse
East side of the city. The route uses a deliberate drop on the 4th floor.
Talk to Jasmine at the top
Her Ampharos is ill. She asks you to fetch medicine from Cianwood.
Collect HM04 Strength
From the sailor in the Olivine Café. You will need it for Cianwood’s Gym.

p: The Lighthouse is one large map; its stairs are arrow tiles you walk into. From the door, the stairs at the far left of 1F go to 2F, and the next set goes to 3F. On 3F take the right-hand stairs up to 4F.

On 4F walk to the two dark floor tiles and step on one: you drop into a small closed room on 3F. Its stairs lead to a side room of 4F, whose narrow corridor runs down to the stairs for 5F, and from there to the top.

Jasmine is beside the sick Ampharos. She asks for medicine from the pharmacy in Cianwood City, across the sea. To get down again, use the pairs of dark tiles near each staircase; Escape Rope does not work in the Lighthouse.
On the southern part of Route 39, near Moomoo Farm, Baoba steps out and registers himself in your Pokégear. He is the warden of Johto’s Safari Zone and will call when it opens.

items: Olivine Café. Needed for the boulders in Cianwood Gym.
stuck: I can’t reach the top of the Lighthouse
On 3F use the right-hand stairs. On 4F step on one of the two dark tiles to drop into the closed 3F room, and climb from there.
Jasmine isn’t in the Gym
She is at the top of the Lighthouse. She returns once you bring the SecretPotion from Cianwood.
next: Surf west from Olivine’s western shore along Routes 40 and 41.
chapters.ev: v100 trace 65–67, 70; notes ‘Olivine Lighthouse route (verified twice)’

chapters.title: Cianwood City
chapters.goal: Fetch the medicine for Jasmine, beat Chuck and receive Fly.
need: Surf, and a Pokémon that knows it or the HM in your Bag.
HM04 Strength for the Gym’s boulders (Olivine Café).
quick: Surf from Olivine’s west shore
Route 40 is entered from the city’s western edge, not from the port beach. Head south, then west along Route 41.
Get the SecretPotion
From the pharmacy in Cianwood.
Solve the Gym’s boulders
Push the middle boulder all the way left, walk round by the left corridor, then push the top boulder right.
Beat Chuck
Reward: Storm Badge and TM01 Focus Punch.
Receive HM02 Fly
Chuck’s wife walks up to you outside the Gym.

p: Olivine, Cianwood and Mahogany can be done in any order, and their Leaders scale with it. Whichever you fight first uses a team around Level 31–33; the second is around 34–36; the third has five Pokémon at 37–38. The guide lists all three versions of each Leader.
The Radio Tower story in Goldenrod only begins after your seventh Badge, whichever of the three Gyms that turns out to be.

Three boulders sit in a column in front of Chuck. Push the middle one all the way to the left along its row. Walk round through the left-hand corridor to stand just left of the top boulder and push it right. Chuck can then be reached from the tile directly below him.
With Strength in your Bag, pressing A on a boulder is enough.

steps.t: Fly, Eusine and the Safari Zone
p: Outside the Gym, Chuck’s wife gives you HM02 Fly. If this was your seventh Badge, Professor Elm calls straight afterwards about the Radio Tower.
Eusine challenges you near the north shore after a glimpse of Suicune (Politoed, Hypno and Electrode, all Level 27). The fight is optional and he waits if you lose.

The Safari Zone is reached from Cianwood: through the Cliff Edge Gate north-west of the Gym, along Route 47, up the stairs inside Cliff Edge Cave to the upper ledge, and across Route 48. Baoba meets you in the entrance building and gives you the Pokéblock Case. Entry costs ¥500 for 30 Safari Balls.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Chuck
know: As the third of the free-order Gyms he brings five Pokémon at Level 37–38, including Annihilape and Pinsir.
Flying and Psychic moves cover most of his team; Intimidate from Gyarados softens it.

bosses.title: Eusine
know: Optional. He stays where he is if you lose.

items: Cianwood pharmacy. Take it to Jasmine at the top of Olivine’s Lighthouse.
From Chuck’s wife outside the Gym after you win.
stuck: How do I reach Cianwood?
Surf from the western edge of Olivine City onto Route 40, go south to Route 41, then west.
I can’t reach Chuck
Push the middle boulder fully left, go round by the left corridor, push the top boulder right, then talk to him from directly below.
Where is the Safari Zone?
Cianwood → Cliff Edge Gate (north-west of the Gym) → Route 47 → the stairs inside Cliff Edge Cave → Route 48 → Safari Zone Gate.
next: Fly to Olivine and take the SecretPotion up the Lighthouse.
chapters.ev: v100 trace 68–70, 81–89; website notes ‘Mahogany / free-order gyms’

chapters.title: Olivine Gym
chapters.goal: Cure the Lighthouse’s Ampharos and challenge Jasmine.
need: The SecretPotion from Cianwood’s pharmacy.
quick: Climb the Lighthouse again
Give Jasmine the SecretPotion at the top.
Go to the Gym
She returns to it.
Beat Jasmine
Reward: Mineral Badge and TM23 Iron Tail.

p: With the Ampharos cured, Jasmine goes back to her Gym. There are no Gym trainers. Her team is Steel-heavy and, even as the first of the three free-order Leaders, already carries five Pokémon including Skarmory, Scizor (Focus Band) and Steelix (Quick Claw).
This is the stretch where the free START Relearn pays off: in the playthrough, Typhlosion relearned Eruption and Double-Edge, and Sudowoodo Wood Hammer, before the winning attempt.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Jasmine
know: Fire is the answer to nearly everything she has. Steelix’s Earthquake is what sweeps Fire types, so keep a Water or Flying type back for it.
Corsola is her odd one out: Grass or Fighting moves deal with it.

stuck: Jasmine is still not in the Gym
Give her the SecretPotion at the top of the Lighthouse first.
next: Fly to Ecruteak and leave by the east gate onto Route 42.

chapters.title: Mahogany Town
chapters.sub: Lake of Rage & the Rocket Hideout
chapters.goal: Follow Lance from the Lake of Rage into Team Rocket’s hideout and shut down the signal.
need: Surf, for Route 42 and the lake.
quick: Reach Mahogany by Route 42
From Ecruteak’s east gate; part of the route is water.
Go north to the Lake of Rage
Surf out to the red Gyarados.
Meet Lance
He sends you to the souvenir shop in Mahogany.
Enter the hideout through the shop
Lance’s Dragonite clears the way.
Get both passwords
Two Rockets give them up when beaten. The door opens only with both.
Tag battle with Lance
Against Ariana and a grunt. Pick up to three Pokémon.
Faint the three Electrode on the left
Lance handles the right-hand three and gives you HM08 Whirlpool.

p: A red Gyarados is thrashing in the middle of the lake north of Mahogany. Surf out to it; it can be caught. Lance is waiting on the shore and asks you to meet him at the souvenir shop in town.

The stairs are behind the shop counter. The hideout has three basement floors of grunts and scientists. Petrel guards one office (Pineco, Larvitar, Magcargo and a Cloyster that sets Spikes; he carries Full Restores). Two Murkrow repeat a password, and two beaten Rockets each give you one: the locked door on B2F opens only when you have both.
Behind it, Ariana and a grunt attack together and Lance joins your side. A selection screen appears: choose up to three Pokémon that can still fight, then Confirm. Fainted Pokémon cannot be chosen.

In the generator room six Electrode power the signal. Battle the three on the left; Lance takes the others. Running from one leaves it in place. When they are down, Lance switches off the machine and gives you HM08 Whirlpool.

bosses.title: Rocket Executive Petrel
know: Cloyster’s Spikes and his Full Restores make this a long fight around Level 31–38. A strong Electric or Grass move for Cloyster helps.

bosses.title: Rocket Executive Ariana
know: A two-against-two battle with Lance as your partner. You bring up to three Pokémon.

items: From Lance in the generator room of the Rocket Hideout.
stuck: The door in the hideout won’t open
You need two passwords. Beat the Rocket in each of the two rooms that hold them; the door checks for both.
The Electrode room does nothing
Battle the three Electrode on the left side. The right-hand three are Lance’s.
Nothing happens after my 5th Badge here
That is correct. The Radio Tower call only comes with your seventh Badge.
next: The Gym in the centre of town.
chapters.ev: v100 trace 71–74; website notes ‘Rocket Hideout’. The lake scene itself is not itemised in the trace.

chapters.title: Mahogany Gym
chapters.goal: Slide across the ice to Pryce.
need: The Rocket Hideout cleared.
quick: Enter the Gym
It is an ice-slide puzzle on two halves.
Lower half
From the door: up one, right to the edge of the ice, slide right, up (Ronald), left, then up into the middle corridor.
Upper half
From the top of the corridor: slide up, left, up (Clarissa), right, right. You stop beside Pryce.
Beat Pryce
Reward: Glacier Badge and TM07 Hail.

p: On ice you keep sliding until something stops you. The route in the quick list was used in the playthrough and passes two of the Gym’s trainers.
As the first of the three free-order Leaders, Pryce has Dewgong (31), Sneasel (32), Jynx (31) and Piloswine (33, Sitrus Berry).

bosses.title: Gym Leader Pryce
know: Fighting moves hit three of his four. Fire and Rock work too, but watch for Water moves from Dewgong.

stuck: I can’t find a way across the ice
Lower half: up one tile, right, slide right, slide up, slide left, slide up. Upper half: slide up, left, up, right, right.
next: Fly to Goldenrod once Elm calls. He calls after your seventh Badge.

chapters.title: Goldenrod Radio Tower
chapters.goal: Free the Director, climb the tower and end Team Rocket’s broadcast.
need: Seven Badges. Elm’s call fires when you earn the seventh, at whichever of Olivine, Cianwood or Mahogany you finish last.
quick: Fly to Goldenrod
Rockets hold the Radio Tower.
Climb to 5F
The ‘Director’ is Petrel in disguise. He gives up the Basement Key.
Underground
South of the tower. The Basement Key opens the locked door in the tunnel.
Rival, then switches
Beat your rival, then press the switches in the order 3, 2, 1.
Free the real Director
In the storage room. He gives you the Card Key.
Back to Radio Tower 3F
Use the Card Key on the shutter, then beat Proton (4F), Ariana and Archer (5F).
Receive the Mega Ring
The Director gives the Rainbow Wing, then Professor Oak arrives with the Mega Ring.

p: A grunt at the door fights you and leaves. Floors 2 to 4 hold eleven Rockets between them. On 5F the Director turns out to be Petrel (Forretress, Pupitar, Cloyster, Magcargo around Level 38). Beating him yields the Basement Key and the news that the real Director is in the Underground warehouse.

The Underground entrance is south of the tower. A Kimono Girl speaks to you on the way to the locked door, which the Basement Key opens. In the switch room your rival appears first. Then press the wall panels in the order 3, 2, 1 to open the shutters toward the storage door.
The storage room has three more Rockets and the Director, who gives you the Card Key. The Department Store basement opening off this room has no way up into the store: walk back the way you came.
On Radio Tower 3F, use the Card Key on the slot beside the shutter. Proton waits on 4F; on 5F you fight Ariana and then Archer, whose Porygon-Z, Gyarados and Slowbro are the hardest team so far.

The Director thanks you with the Rainbow Wing. Then, in a scene unique to Project Blonde, Professor Oak arrives on 5F and gives you the Mega Ring. From this moment the aide in Elm’s lab will hand out Mega Stones for free.

bosses.title: Rocket Executive Archer
know: Heal between Ariana and Archer if you can: they are fought back to back.
Porygon-Z hits hard and fast; lead with something bulky or Fighting.

items: From the Director in the Underground storage room.
From Professor Oak on Radio Tower 5F after Archer. It enables Mega Evolution.
stuck: Nothing is happening in Goldenrod
The takeover starts only after your seventh Badge. Finish all three of Olivine, Cianwood and Mahogany.
The shutters in the Underground stay shut
Press the switches in the order 3, 2, 1.
How do I get past the shutter on 3F?
You need the Card Key from the real Director in the Underground storage room.
next: Fly to Mahogany and go east along Route 44 into the Ice Path.

chapters.title: Blackthorn City
chapters.goal: Cross the Ice Path, beat Clair and pass the Dragon’s Den test for the Rising Badge.
need: Strength for the Ice Path’s boulders.
Surf and Whirlpool for the Dragon’s Den.
quick: Enter the Ice Path from Route 44
Slide across 1F to the ladder down.
Push four boulders into four holes on B1F
Each lands on B2F and becomes a stopper for the ice below.
Free the Kimono Girl
Near the exit on 1F. Talk to her from above and agree to push.
Beat Clair
She refuses to give the Badge and sends you to the Dragon’s Den.
Dragon’s Den
Behind the Gym. Surf, cross the whirlpool, and answer the Elder’s five questions.
Collect the Badge and TM59
Clair arrives in the shrine; she apologises outside with TM59 Dragon Pulse.
See Elm and take HM07
Elm calls: he has a Master Ball for you. HM07 Waterfall is an item ball back in the Ice Path.

p: On B1F there are four boulders and four holes. Push each boulder into a hole with Strength; it falls to B2F and stops you sliding past on the ice there. You can also drop through a hole yourself. The way on runs from B2F down to B4F and back up to the exit side of 1F. The rocks on B4F are optional and hide a Never-Melt Ice.
Near the exit a Kimono Girl’s sandals are frozen to the floor. Talk to her from the tile above, facing down, and say yes to give her a shove.
HM07 Waterfall is an item ball on 1F, on the entrance side, reached across the small patch of ice there. It is easy to walk past; come back for it before Victory Road.
Four trigger points along the way through the Gym raise the bridges ahead of you in turn. Clair’s team is Dragonair, Gyarados (Focus Band), Lapras, Dudunsparce and Kingdra (Level 45, Leftovers).
She will not accept the result. Go to the Dragon’s Den.

The den is entered behind the Gym. Surf across the cavern; a whirlpool blocks the way to the shrine and is crossed by pressing A at it with HM08 in your Bag. Inside the shrine the Elder asks five questions. The answers that pass are the 1st, 1st, 2nd, 1st and 3rd options.

Clair arrives and hands over the Rising Badge. Outside the shrine she adds TM59 Dragon Pulse. Back in Blackthorn, Elm phones about a Master Ball: collect it from his desk in New Bark Town. He also mentions the Kimono Girls.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Clair
know: Her Gyarados sweeps teams that expect only Dragons: bring Electric or Rock.
Kingdra has no common weakness in this fight except Dragon and Fairy.
Healing items in battle are worth using here.

items: Item ball on Ice Path 1F, entrance side.
From Clair outside the Dragon’s Den shrine.
From Professor Elm in his lab after the eighth Badge.
stuck: Clair won’t give me the Badge
Go to the Dragon’s Den behind the Gym and pass the Elder’s quiz: 1st, 1st, 2nd, 1st, 3rd answers.
A Kimono Girl is blocking the Ice Path
Talk to her from the tile above her, facing down, and choose yes to push her free.
Where is Waterfall?
An item ball on the ground floor of the Ice Path, on the Mahogany side.
next: Fly to Ecruteak and enter the Dance Theater.

chapters.title: The Kimono Girls
chapters.goal: Win five battles in a row at the Dance Theater and climb the Tin Tower.
need: All eight Johto Badges and the Rainbow Wing.
The Reception Gate on the way to the League will not open until this chapter is finished.
quick: Enter the Dance Theater
Your rival storms out as you arrive.
Beat five Kimono Girls in a row
Umbreon, Espeon, Flareon, Jolteon, Vaporeon, all Level 48. No healing in between except items.
Receive the Clear Bell
They leave for the Tin Tower.
Pass the sage offices
North of the city. The sage steps aside when he hears the bell.
Climb the Tin Tower
Ladders to 7F, then a chain of warp pads to the roof.
Meet Ho-Oh
The Kimono Girls dance; talk to Ho-Oh from below. Level 50.

p: Zuki, at the middle of the stage, starts the gauntlet. Each Kimono Girl has one Eeveelution at Level 48 and they come one after another, so bring healing items and a varied party. Losing means starting again from the first.
They give you the Clear Bell and go ahead to the tower.

Floors 1 to 7 are climbed by ladders; 3F and 8F have one-way ledge rows. From 7F the rest is warp pads. The chain that reaches the roof: 7F’s lower pad, then each new pad you arrive beside on 9F and 8F in turn. The other 7F pad leads into a loop that only brings you back. Pads work only when you step onto them freshly.
Wild Pokémon appear indoors here (Gastly, Misdreavus, Mismagius and others around Level 36–42).
Walk forward and the Kimono Girls dance. Ho-Oh descends; speak to it from below to battle. It is Level 50 and appears once: save beforehand. The Master Ball from Elm is the obvious tool.
Neither Escape Rope nor Fly works on the roof. Take the pad back down to 8F and use an Escape Rope there.

bosses.title: The Kimono Girls
know: Five single battles back to back. A physical Water or Ground type covers Flareon and Jolteon; Dark or Bug handles Espeon.

items: From the Kimono Girls after you beat all five.
stuck: The guard at the Reception Gate won’t let me through
You need all eight Badges and to have finished the Kimono Girls and Tin Tower chapter.
I’m stuck on the Tin Tower roof
Fly and Escape Rope are disabled there. Step on the pad to return to 8F, then use an Escape Rope.
The warp pads loop
From 7F use the pad that takes you to the top-left of 9F, and keep taking each new pad you land next to.
next: Fly to New Bark Town and Surf east onto Route 27.

chapters.title: Victory Road
chapters.goal: Cross into Kanto, pass the Reception Gate and climb Victory Road.
need: Eight Johto Badges and the Kimono Girls chapter (the Reception Gate checks).
Surf, Waterfall and Strength. The HMs only need to be in your Bag.
quick: Surf east from New Bark Town
Route 27 begins: your first step into Kanto.
Tohjo Falls
Surf to the foot of the left waterfall, press A to climb, cross the top pool and ride down the right fall.
Routes 27 and 26
Trainers around Level 45–50.
Reception Gate
The guard checks your eight Badges.
Victory Road
A maze of ladders and drop holes with two Strength boulders. See the route below.
Battle your rival
He waits just before the exit.

p: Inside the cave, Surf to the base of the left waterfall and press A to go up. Walk right along the upper pool and Surf down the right-hand fall to the east exit.
The cave has three floors and you enter on the lowest. B2F: push the boulder north of the entrance upward, and take the ladder in the far north-west.

B1F: take the ladder on the east side up to a small pocket of 1F and drop into the hole beside it. You land in B1F’s eastern section: push the boulder in the one-tile corridor west twice and climb the ladder in the north-east.
1F: walk down the right side to the middle strip and drop into the hole there. Back on B1F, a ladder a few steps away brings you up into 1F’s central area. The exit is the door at the top.
Wild Pokémon are Level 42–45 (Rhydon, Donphan, Golem, Sandslash, Golbat, Onix). Your rival ambushes you just before the door with six Pokémon led by Ursaring.

bosses.title: Rival
know: Six Pokémon, Level 45–48, including Tyranitar. Arrive healed: there is no Pokémon Center inside.

stuck: The gate guard turns me away
Eight Badges are not enough on their own: finish the Kimono Girls and the Tin Tower first.
I can’t get up Tohjo Falls
Use the left waterfall: Surf to its foot and press A. Waterfall only has to be in your Bag.
I’m going in circles in Victory Road
The way through uses two deliberate drops: the hole beside the small 1F pocket, and the hole in the middle strip of 1F.
next: Route 23, north of Victory Road’s exit.

chapters.title: Indigo Plateau
chapters.goal: Beat the Elite Four and the Champion in one run.
need: A team around Level 60 and a stock of healing items. The Elite Four are Level 48–56 with held items and two Full Restores each.
quick: Heal and shop in the League Center
Ultra Ball, Hyper Potion, Max Potion, Full Restore, Full Heal, Revive, Max Repel and vitamins.
Enter by the door at the top right
Each room locks behind you.
Will, Koga, Bruno, Karen
In that order.
Champion Lance
Three Dragonite; the last one Mega Evolves.
Hall of Fame and credits
Then the title screen. Continue resumes in New Bark Town.

p: This League is tuned well above the Gyms. A party that walked straight in from Blackthorn at Level 43–56 lost eleven times in a row in the playthrough; it won at roughly Level 66–74 with Hyper Potions used in battle. Aim for about Level 60 with a full Bag.

Each loss costs money, and the first prize (Will’s) does not cover it, so an underlevelled party can run out of funds. Route 27’s trainers and the Victory Road wilds are the place to train. Use START Relearn to refit movesets for each member.
If you lose, you appear outside the League Center with your party healed. Walking back into the Center resets the challenge to Will, as the Black Belt inside warns.

Will boosts and passes with Baton Pass. Koga stalls with Double Team, Minimize, Toxic and Confuse Ray, and his Crobat holds Bright Powder: bring moves that never miss, or Full Heals. Bruno hits hard and straightforwardly. Karen’s Umbreon and Houndoom punish Psychic and Ghost teams.

Lance’s Gyarados (Leftovers, Intimidate, Dragon Dance) is the sweeper to stop early. His Dragonite carry Thunder and Extreme Speed, Aerodactyl has Rock Slide and Earthquake, and his last Dragonite Mega Evolves.

After the battle Mary and Professor Oak arrive, Lance takes you to the Hall of Fame, and the credits run. The game returns to the title screen; choose Continue and you are outside your house in New Bark Town, where Elm calls at once.

bosses.title: Champion Lance
know: Ice moves are four times effective on Dragonite; Rock handles Aerodactyl, Charizard and Gyarados.
Stop Gyarados before it sets up Dragon Dance.

stuck: I keep losing to Koga
His team wins by evasion and poison. Carry Full Heals, use moves that cannot miss, and come back at a higher level.
I ran out of money
Each loss costs more than Will’s prize. Train on Route 27 and Victory Road rather than retrying immediately.
After the credits I’m back at the title screen
That is the ending. Choose Continue: you resume in New Bark Town and the Kanto story begins.
next: Talk to Professor Elm in New Bark Town.
